When do you guys start your seeds indoors?

I start about mid September with most perennials, and mid January is when I start with annuals. Annuals stretch out to right before my last frost date.

Regular shop lights, with flats in disposable roasting pans for the most part. I keep the lights no more than 6 inches from the plants, so that means rearranging when some get too tall. Once they don't fit on the starting shelves, they go into the cold frame or now the greenhouse.
